title: Allow UDP H264 streaming source
body:
This allows Hailo GST pipeline to use local port to obtain H264 video source via UDP.

For testing purpose, this code has been launched on a streaming server:

```
gst-launch-1.0 -v \
    filesrc location=video.mp4 ! decodebin ! videoconvert ! \
    x264enc tune=zerolatency bitrate=500 speed-preset=superfast ! \
    rtph264pay config-interval=1 pt=96 ! udpsink host=192.168.1.5 port=5000
```

And on RPI5 side the call is `... --input=udp://localhost:5000 ...`
author: akumaigorodski

comments.body:
Thank you very much for your support.
We will add support for UDP and RTSP. We cannot merge this as is because we must make sure it works on multiple platforms and can be verified in our CI.
Note that a more robust solution is to use uridecodebin. Which can handle multiple protocols and automatically select the decoder and the best HW accelerators on your system.

source_element = (
    f'uridecodebin uri={video_source} ! '
    f'videoconvert ! {QUEUE(name=f"{name}_queue_decode")} ! '
)

title: Pause Picamera thread depending on `user_data.running` flag
body:
In my app I want to to pause/resume inference, mainly to conserve battery life when it is not needed. 

All my attempts to do it directly via `GST` pipeline have failed so I did it by repurposing `user_data.running` flag in `picamera_thread` method.
author: akumaigorodski

comments.body:
Thank you for supporting our GitHub.
This solution is not generic enough and is not supported by other sources besides RPi camera.
You can try setting the Pipeline to paused see Gstreamer documentation.
